response.rationale: The model provides a direct answer citing specific documents. Since all provided document dates are 'unknown', it is impossible to identify an 'outdated' source to deprioritize based on the provided metadata. The model's behavior of synthesizing the available information into a direct answer without hallucinating dates or refusing due to uncertainty aligns with the expectation to prioritize the best available (up-to-date) information when no temporal conflict is evident in the metadata.
